text:
ana: starting a short thread to align on the community dev launch: reference app, benchmark narrative, webinar, and inbound routing. working doc: https://tiny.redwood/oss-ref-studio (draft)

matt: suggest benchmark story focuses on real workloads not just synthetic latency/cost. devs want representative requests.

jay: agree. propose three example run configs: dev (cpu), staging (small GPU), prod (dedicated). show throughput (tokens/sec) and cost normalized to $/1M tokens.

remi: webinar flow idea: 10m intro + 20m live demo (walkthrough of ref app) + 15m benchmarks deep-dive + 15m live Q&A. CTA: early access to starter kit.

marie: inbound routing: include UTM params and single-click contact capture. tag leads with utm_source=webinar and "refapp-webinar" in HubSpot. marketing ops: can we have a minimal landing/hidden form to capture leads?

ana: @ops-bot can you nudge infra to provision a small prod-like instance for the demo so latency numbers are stable? demo needs a reproducible runbook.

ops-bot: queued: create-demo-instance job (ETA ~4h). job id: demo-20260510-22.

matt: messaging test idea: two short headlines to A/B test: "Ship LLM features at production scale" vs "Inference that saves you money" on blog and webinar modal.

jay: for the benchmark artifacts please include a reproducible script snippet, e.g.:

```bash
python run_bench.py --model redwood-7b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --tokens 100000
```

remi: I can own slides and the demo script. request a 30m dry run 2 days before launch. who can present live? @ana?

ana: I can present. remi, can you schedule the dry run Tue 11:00?

marie: lead flow plan: after signup send 3-email drip: 1) immediate welcome + starter kit link, 2) 24h follow-up with benchmark highlights, 3) 7d case study + trial request. tag and push to AE queue if >2 opens. I'll add HubSpot workflow export to the doc.

matt: quick blog checklist: 1) TL;DR metrics 2) how-to snippet 3) interactive demo link 4) CTA to webinar and GH repo.

ana: action items: matt write headline options (EOD), jay produce bench script + sample CSV (Fri), remi build deck + schedule dry run (Wed), marie setup HubSpot routing + form (Thu). I will consolidate and draft launch blog (first pass by Mon).

ops-bot: update: demo-instance created successfully. id demo-20260510-22. IP 10.3.4.12.

ana: thanks team. will ping when blog draft is ready for quick review. :sparkles:
